hooks.command: jq -c '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:("Subagent \(.tool_input.subagent_type // "general-purpose") on model: \(.tool_input.model // "NOT SET (agent default / inherited)") | \(.tool_input.description // "")")}}'

jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("\\bgit\\s+push\\b") or test("\\bgit\\s+commit\\b.*\\s(-[a-zA-Z]*m|--message)")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Run git commit -m and git push with the Bash tool (Git Bash), not PowerShell: Windows PowerShell 5.1 splits arguments at quotes inside them, and its git push may have no sign-in. Commit with git commit -F - and a heredoc."}} else empty end'
